changelog:
- Initial release of the thinking-triz skill for resolving technical design contradictions without compromise.
- Provides a step-by-step TRIZ-inspired framework: name the contradiction, seek separations (time, space, condition, scale), and apply inventive transforms if needed.
- Clearly outlines when TRIZ should and should not be applied, avoiding overuse or inappropriate cases.
- Defines structured output fields for documenting both the contradiction and resolution.
- Includes verification guidelines to ensure proper, non-decorative use of the method.
summary: When two design requirements seem mutually exclusive, name the contradiction, separate conflicting states, then invent a concrete no-compromise resolution.
